brief: Add an operation named `reverse` to the registry in `examples/conductor-self-drive/src/operations.ts`. It returns the input string with its characters in the opposite order. Register it alongside the existing operations so that `tsx examples/conductor-self-drive/src/cli.ts --list` shows it and `tsx examples/conductor-self-drive/src/cli.ts reverse <input>` runs it. Give it a one-line summary, matching the style of the entries already there, and keep the file dependency-free.
